note: LLM composer backends; 'active' picks one (see docs/RESEARCH-llm.md). Local profiles keep conversation text on the device; cloud/API profiles send the frame (partner's words, intent, referent) to the provider. Keys come from the named environment variable (or `ant auth login` for Anthropic), never from this file.

mac_qwen35_4b.note: primary local (Mac): `ollama pull qwen3.5:4b`; Apache-2.0, IFEval 89.8 per its model card; ~1.7-2.1 s est. on M5 Air

mac_gemma4_e2b.note: fast local fallback: `ollama pull gemma4:e2b`; ~1.3 s est. on M5 Air

mac_gemma4_e4b.note: step up if e2b quality is short and latency allows; ~2.2 s est.

claude_haiku.note: primary API: official SDK, native JSON schema; $0.10/$0.50 per MTok; needs ANTHROPIC_API_KEY or `ant auth login`

groq_gpt_oss_20b.note: free-tier fallback; check Groq data terms before sending real conversations

ollama_cloud_gemma4.note: Ollama cloud via the local app (off-device; no structured outputs); used for the Windows evaluation
